kill_chain_signals.contact: Victims are contacted on dating apps/websites or social media by fraudsters; unsolicited messages from strangers on social media, dating apps/websites and text messages
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Fraudsters attempting to develop a relationship to gain trust; fraudster then claims to have been successful in cryptocurrency investments and offers to help the victim get rich
kill_chain_signals.payment: Convince victims to transfer funds or cryptocurrency into their trading account on fake online trading platforms
kill_chain_signals.movement: Victims transfer increasing amounts of money; once a substantial amount of money or crypto is sent
kill_chain_signals.cashout: Victim being unable to withdraw their funds; the scammer abruptly ceases contact; fraudster agrees to return money but demands additional funds for supposed taxes and fees before disappearing

red_flags: Unsolicited messages from strangers on social media, dating apps/websites and text messages leading to prolonged exchanges, often moving to private messaging apps
Mention of easy money made in the crypto market, often based on exclusive information or through professional traders
Encouragement to visit crypto-related websites using terms like investment packages and guaranteed rates of return
Provision of financial records showing returns or allowing a small withdrawal to create a false sense of legitimacy
Promises of large, quick, and low-risk returns
key_quote: Victims are contacted on dating apps/websites or social media by fraudsters attempting to develop a relationship to gain trust.
title: Warning on crypto and romance frauds
